schema.name: artifact_comments
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_comments (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      quote TEXT NOT NULL,
      -- On a whiteboard: the item or connector (JSON), see ArtifactCommentAnchor.
      anchor TEXT,
      comments TEXT NOT NULL,
      resolved_by TEXT,
      resolved_at INTEGER,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: artifact_feedback
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_feedback (
      artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      round INTEGER NOT NULL,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      notify TEXT NOT NULL,
      items TEXT NOT NULL,
      images TEXT NOT NULL,
      done_by TEXT,
      done_at INTEGER,
      summary TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id, round)
    )

schema.name: artifact_shared
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_shared (
    artifact_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    state BLOB NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: artifact_versions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_versions (
      artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      author TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id, version)
    )

schema.name: artifacts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifacts (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      node_id TEXT,
      version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      -- The summary lists show (JSON), worked out once per version rather than per list.
      preview TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      -- The agent that wrote it last; it hears about the user's edits.
      last_agent TEXT,
      open_comments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      commented_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: attention_waiters
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE attention_waiters (
      attention_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (attention_id, thread_id)
    )

schema.name: attentions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE attentions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      thread_id TEXT,
      conversation_id TEXT,
      message_id TEXT,
      block TEXT NOT NULL,
      closed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      answer TEXT,
      withdrawn TEXT,
      approved INTEGER,
      purpose TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      -- The event that last changed what the row shows, for pages that fetch only changes.
      changed_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )

schema.name: conversations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE conversations (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      role TEXT NOT NULL,
      pending_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      pending_since INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      turn_id TEXT,
      turn_started_seq INTEGER,
      turn_started_at INTEGER,
      -- When its newest turn started, kept after it ends: was there a report since?
      last_turn_at INTEGER,
      model TEXT,
      last_outcome TEXT,
      last_error TEXT,
      input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cached_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cache_write_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      reasoning_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cost_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      cost_cny REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      context_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      instructions TEXT,
      activity TEXT,
      -- The turn went on with the fallback model.
      fallback INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      compactions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      wait_id TEXT,
      wait_until INTEGER,
      wait_note TEXT
    )

schema.name: events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
      seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      data TEXT NOT NULL,
      at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: files
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE files (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    mime TEXT NOT NULL,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    data BLOB NOT NULL,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: issue_writes
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE issue_writes (
      attention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
      thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tracker TEXT NOT NULL,
      number INTEGER NOT NULL,
      action TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT NOT NULL,
      url TEXT,
      written_seq INTEGER
    )

schema.name: memories
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE memories (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      text TEXT NOT NULL,
      author TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: messages
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      author TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      edited_at INTEGER,
      edit_reason TEXT,
      original_content TEXT,
      read_at INTEGER,
      edited_since_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      blocks TEXT,
      attachments TEXT,
      mentions TEXT,
      comments TEXT,
      -- On a relay: the user's messages it passes along. On a user's message: the relays
      -- that passed it to threads.
      cites TEXT,
      relayed_to TEXT,
      -- The message it answers (JSON QuotedMessage), and the emojis on it (JSON Reaction[]).
      reply_to TEXT,
      reactions TEXT,
      -- The event that last changed the row, for pages that fetch only changes.
      changed_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )

schema.name: notices
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE notices (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL,
      undone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      -- The event that last changed the row, for pages that fetch only changes.
      changed_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )

schema.name: plan_edges
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_edges (
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      from_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      to_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      changed_in TEXT,
      PRIMARY KEY (project_id, from_id, to_id)
    )

schema.name: plan_node_issues
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_node_issues (
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tracker TEXT NOT NULL,
      number INTEGER NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      url TEXT NOT NULL,
      linked_by TEXT NOT NULL,
      seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (project_id, node_id, tracker, number)
    )

schema.name: plan_nodes
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_nodes (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL,
      acceptance TEXT NOT NULL,
      position INTEGER NOT NULL,
      changed_in TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (project_id, id)
    )

schema.name: plan_proposals
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_proposals (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      attention_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      ops TEXT NOT NULL,
      revert_of TEXT,
      status TEXT NOT NULL,
      stale_reason TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: plan_revisions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE plan_revisions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      author TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      ops TEXT NOT NULL,
      inverse TEXT NOT NULL,
      revert_of TEXT,
      reverted_by TEXT,
      proposal_id TEXT,
      seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: projects
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE projects (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      coordinator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      source TEXT,
      -- Sources the project only reads, as JSON.
      reference_sources TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      slots INTEGER,
      mcp TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      settings TEXT,
      -- What Ariadne found out about the repository itself (JSON, ProjectDetected).
      detected TEXT,
      -- The user paused its autopilot; and the event at which it last went on (switched on
      -- or resumed).
      autopilot_paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      autopilot_since INTEGER,
      -- Its name is only the start of the user's first words, until someone names it.
      unnamed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: prompts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE prompts (
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (project_id, hash)
    )

schema.name: reviews
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE reviews (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      round INTEGER NOT NULL,
      head TEXT,
      requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      verdict TEXT,
      summary TEXT,
      comments TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      replies TEXT,
      submitted_at INTEGER,
      abandoned_at INTEGER
    )

schema.name: search_docs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE search_docs (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      ref_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      conversation_id TEXT,
      at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: search_text
schema.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search_text USING fts5(title, body, tokenize = 'trigram')

schema.name: threads
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE threads (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      node_id TEXT,
      started INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_report TEXT,
      last_summary TEXT,
      last_headline TEXT,
      -- Ids of the artifacts it pointed the user to (JSON), shown by their current titles.
      last_artifacts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      reported_at INTEGER,
      reported_head TEXT,
      -- When it was last told to report after a turn that ended without one.
      nudged_at INTEGER,
      workspace_label TEXT,
      workspace_branch TEXT,
      workspace_base TEXT,
      workspace_removed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      workspace_parked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      merged TEXT,
      -- When its work last landed (its branch or pull request was merged), and when the
      -- user last wrote to it: landed with nothing written since, it is archived.
      landed_at INTEGER,
      user_at INTEGER,
      -- What its workspace changes against the base (JSON ChangeTotals), as of its last
      -- turn that changed something.
      changes TEXT,
      pull_request TEXT,
      -- The sources it alone reads (JSON ThreadReference[]).
      reference_sources TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      reference_ended TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      check_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      stopped_reason TEXT,
      stopped_by TEXT,
      stopped_at INTEGER,
      reviewed_at INTEGER,
      model TEXT,
      branch_slug TEXT,
      -- For a reviewing thread: the author it reviews.
      review_of TEXT,
      -- For an author: its reviewing thread, the rounds of its latest delivery, whether a
      -- round runs now, and whether that delivery reached the user.
      reviewer_id TEXT,
      review_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      reviewing INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      review_delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      -- The branch commit the autopilot last left for the user (empty for none), so it does
      -- not try that commit again.
      autopilot_held TEXT,
      auto INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      -- Set aside until this time, why and by whom; due once that time came.
      aside_until INTEGER,
      aside_reason TEXT,
      aside_by TEXT,
      aside_due INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: todos
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE todos (
      conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      items TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: transcript
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE transcript (

schema.name: used_approvals
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE used_approvals (

      thread_id TEXT NOT NULL
    )
